title: Lab 1: First agent
question: Set up a Python environment and write a first LLM agent that answers questions and calls one tool. Submit the complete code.

title: Lab 2: ReAct agent
question: Implement a ReAct agent with a calculator or search tool that shows Thought, Action and Observation steps. Write the full code.

title: Lab 3: Conversation memory
question: Add conversation memory to a chatbot so it remembers previous messages across turns. Provide the complete implementation.

title: Lab 4: RAG with FAISS or Chroma
question: Build a RAG pipeline that loads a PDF, splits it into chunks, stores embeddings in FAISS or ChromaDB and answers questions. Write the full code for the RAG pipeline.

title: Lab 5: Document QA agent
question: Create a document question answering agent over multiple PDFs with source citations. Give the complete solution code.

title: Lab 6: Planner and executor
question: Build a multi-agent workflow with a planner agent that creates steps and an executor agent that performs them. Write the entire program.

title: Lab 7: Guardrails
question: Add input and output guardrails to an LLM chatbot to block prompt injection and remove personal data. Provide the full code for the guardrails.

title: Lab 8: Evaluation metrics
question: Write an evaluation script that measures task completion rate and tool-call accuracy of an agent on a test set. Give the complete code.

title: Lab 9: FastAPI deployment
question: Deploy an agent as a FastAPI endpoint POST /ask that returns JSON. Write the complete FastAPI application code.

title: Quiz 2, Q3 (graded)
question: Quiz question: Compare ReAct and Plan-and-Execute with an example and state two advantages of each. (5 marks)
